# fireworks_deployment (Data Source)

Look up an existing deployment by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fireworks_deployment" "existing" {
  id = "abc123"
}

output "deployment_state" {
  value = data.fireworks_deployment.existing.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Deployment ID.

### Read-Only

- `accelerator_type` (String) GPU type serving the deployment.
- `base_model` (String) Model the deployment serves.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `max_replica_count` (Number) Maximum replicas for autoscaling.
- `min_replica_count` (Number) Minimum replicas; 0 means scale-to-zero is enabled.
- `name` (String) Full resource name, e.g. accounts/my-account/deployments/abc123.
- `precision` (String) Model serving precision.
- `state` (String) Current deployment state (CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DELETING, FAILED).
